title: What Is AIVideosUGC? Company Facts | AIVideosUGC

lead: What is AIVideosUGC? It turns product photos into store images and short video ads, or product page links into video. AIVideosUGC does not add voiceover, music, or captions. Add offer text in your editor after download.
summary: AIVideosUGC is an online tool that turns a product photo or a product page link into short video ads and store-ready product images for online stores.
facts: AI video ad and product photo tool for online stores
Ecommerce sellers, brands that sell through their own online stores, and marketers on Shopify, Amazon, TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook
6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds; 9:16, 1:1 or 16:9; made from a product photo, a product page link or a text description

describe: AIVideosUGC turns a product photo or product page link into short vertical video ads and store-ready product images, with the credit cost shown before each job.

faq.a: An online tool that turns a product photo or a product page link into short video ads and store-ready product images for online stores.
Monthly plans start at $24.50 with 200 credits. The credit cost of each video or photo is shown before it is made.

faq.q: Does AIVideosUGC add spoken narration or music?
faq.a: AIVideosUGC does not add voiceover, music, or captions. Add music, a voiceover, or captions in your editor after download.

faq.q: What video settings can I choose?
faq.a: Choose 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds and 9:16, 1:1, or 16:9. The workspace currently offers 6, 10, and 15 seconds; 30 seconds is the planned public option.
